summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (SMFG) files Form 6-K announcing a share acquisition by the ESOP Trust for its employee share-based compensation plan. The board resolved on May 13, 2026, to authorize the trustee to acquire up to 1,094,000 common shares for a total cost not exceeding JPY 6,564,000,000 (approx. $47M). The acquisition will occur on the open market between May 21-29, 2026. The ESOP Trust runs until May 2029, with voting rights exercised per an independent administrator's instructions. This is a routine employee compensation share buyback, not a special situation.
